visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on a clear acrylic sphere containing four small, dark lunar rock fragments. The sphere is mounted on a wooden pedestal next to a small Republic of China flag. The lighting is bright and directed, emphasizing the textures of the stone and the flag's fabric. (2) A wide shot reveals a museum display case in a dimly lit hall. The acrylic sphere and the ROC flag are central, surrounded by plaques with Traditional Chinese text. The background features glowing digital screens and dark architectural elements typical of a modern museum setting. (3) Archival black-and-white footage shows an astronaut in a full white space suit standing on the desolate, cratered lunar surface. The Lunar Module is partially visible in the background, set against the pitch-black sky of the moon. (4) Close-up archival footage depicts a gloved hand using a long sampling tool to pick up rocks and soil from the moon's surface. The movements are slow and deliberate, reflecting the low-gravity environment and the precision of the scientific mission. (5) In a laboratory setting, a scientist wearing full white protective gear and gloves works within a sealed glove box. They are carefully examining small geological samples, representing the post-mission analysis phase. (6) The camera pans across a museum exhibit, showing digital displays titled "MARS TREASURES" and rotating back to the lunar rock display. The lighting is professional and museum-grade, with high contrast between the exhibits and the dark walkways.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 全台唯一來自月球的岩石. [Logo]: FLUORESCENT MINERALS. [Variety]: 星期天配音是對的. (2) [Subtitle]: 這個壓克力球裡面的四個小點. (3) [Subtitle]: 就是全台灣唯一絕無僅有的四顆月球岩石標本. (4) [Subtitle]: 這是全台灣唯一一份來自月球的岩石標本. (5) [Subtitle]: 1969年阿波羅11號登上月球. (6) [Subtitle]: 太空人從月球表面採集了21.5公斤的月球標本. (7) [Subtitle]: 除了實驗的用途以外也有一部分被小心封進透明的壓克力球裡. (8) [Subtitle]: 成為象徵人類共享科學成果的紀念品. (9) [Subtitle]: 你現在看到的這一面中華民國國旗. (10) [Subtitle]: 也是真的跟著阿波羅11號上過月球再回到地球. (11) [Subtitle]: 當時的美國總共把這份禮物送給135個聯合國會員國. (12) [Subtitle]: 中華民國就是其中之一. (13) [Subtitle]: 而這一個將人類初次登月的地質標本興奮地致贈給各國長官的歷史時刻. (14) [Subtitle]: 也被稱為睦質外交.
